name: find-p2-desk
proves: Player 2 finds the Circle of Power on the desk: its close-up, find and tutorial words in their Tome all end, and they walk off. A close-up of theirs now lasts through a script's hold, so this checks one that ends in a find. Player 1 walks through it. They're put at the desk (ED_COOP_P2_PUT), not walked there.
source: player 2's presses from logs/run-20261104-012821-p2cam-fix, then scrolls and presses for the words
